other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Punjab.
Applicant must be between 18 and 60 years of age for registration as a construction worker.
Applicant must have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
Monthly income must be ₹15,000 or below.
Applicant must not be a member of any other welfare fund established under any law.
Applicant must not be a member of the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF), National Pension System (NPS), or Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC).
Applicant must not be an income tax payer.
Applicant must be a registered construction worker with the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Punjab.
Applicant must have completed at least 3 years of membership with the Board.
Applicant must be above 60 years of age to receive the pension.
Applicant must be continuously depositing contributions to the Board.
